description:
Step away from the restrictive and into a new realm of relaxed sophistication with the Men’s Baggy Cord Pants in Green by Gorur Ghash. Consider these your official resignation from the skinny jean olympics. They are a statement of profound comfort and a nod to timeless style, expertly reimagined for the modern wardrobe. Designed for those who value both their personal space and freedom of movement, these pants offer the perfect foundation for a versatile and expressive style. They masterfully blend the laid-back energy of streetwear with the rich, textural heritage of a classic fabric, creating a piece that feels both current and enduringly, effortlessly cool.

 

The soul of these pants lies in their premium, ribbed corduroy construction. The distinct vertical wales of the corduroy provide a satisfying texture that elevates them far beyond ordinary casual wear. This fabric is renowned for its unique combination of softness and durability, offering a comfortable feel against the skin while being robust enough for daily life, from navigating busy city streets to contemplating important life decisions on your couch. The green hue enhances this texture, allowing light to play off the ribs and create a sense of visual depth. It’s a material that feels as good as it looks, promising year-round wearability that adapts to any season with an easygoing grace.

 

Embracing a deliberately baggy fit, these pants are engineered for a silhouette that’s all about an effortless drape. The cut is relaxed through the hip and thigh, freeing you to walk, skate, or execute a spontaneous dance move without a second thought. This isn’t just comfort; it’s about curating a specific, modern look that says “I’m stylish, but I also enjoy breathing.” Functionality is seamlessly integrated with four deep, practical pockets—two at the sides and two at the back. They’re spacious enough for your phone, wallet, keys, and maybe a smuggled croissant for later. These pockets offer the utility you need without disrupting the pants’ clean, relaxed lines, proving that practical can indeed be very cool.

 

Available in 5 sizes (S, M, L, XL & XXL) for men on Gorur Ghash’s Facebook and Instagram account and website. Proudly Made in Bangladesh (BD)!

Whether you’re a craftsman, creator, or someone who appreciates gear with purpose, this detail adds professional-grade functionality to your everyday outfit.

 

The reinforced stitching and strong belt loops are subtle nods to traditional workwear, while the clean lines and structured gabardine elevate the overall look. description:
Step away from the restrictive and into a new realm of relaxed sophistication with the Men’s Baggy Cord Pants in Off-White by Gorur Ghash. Consider these your official resignation from the skinny jean olympics. They are a statement of profound comfort and a nod to timeless style, expertly reimagined for the modern wardrobe. Designed for those who value both their personal space and freedom of movement, these pants offer the perfect foundation for a versatile and expressive style. They masterfully blend the laid-back energy of streetwear with the rich, textural heritage of a classic fabric, creating a piece that feels both current and enduringly, effortlessly cool.

description:
Discover the definitive piece for your warm-weather wardrobe with the Pleated Summer Shorts in Cream by Gorur Ghash. Expertly designed for that elusive sweet spot between elevated style and genuine comfort, these shorts present a sophisticated solution for navigating the season’s heat. Let’s call it the official truce in the annual war against sweltering temperatures. They serve as a foundational garment, seamlessly blending the polish of tailored wear with the ease required for daily life, making it an indispensable ally for any summer occasion.

 

The key to its superior performance lies in the high-quality polyester fabric. This carefully selected material is engineered to be exceptionally lightweight and breathable, allowing for optimal air circulation to keep you cool when the weather has other plans. Its advanced moisture-wicking properties diligently draw perspiration away from the skin, ensuring you stay dry and fresh from a morning coffee run to an evening outing.

 

A defining feature of these shorts is the sharp, visible pleating. These are not arbitrary folds; they are intentional, structured details that add a refined dimension to the silhouette. The pleats create a graceful drape that allows the shorts to move with you, offering a flattering fit that’s both forgiving and chic. This tailored element elevates the shorts beyond a simple casual item, lending it an air of intentional design that quietly announces you have your life together, even if you’re just winging it.

 

The timeless cream colorway ensures these shorts are incredibly versatile and almost laughably easy to style. For a classic, minimalist look, pair it with a simple cotton t-shirt or a silk camisole. To create a more structured ensemble for the office or a dinner date, they match effortlessly with a tailored blazer and loafers. Its adaptability makes it suitable for a wide range of settings, proving that one smart garment can indeed solve a multitude of “what to wear” dilemmas. Embrace this blend of refined style and intelligent design, and make summer dressing elegantly simple.

description:
Introducing Plaantik 10 Year Commemorative Blackout Unisex Tee in collaboration with Gorur Ghash!  This exclusive limited-edition streetwear hass been launched to celebrate the 10-year anniversary of the football media company. The unique all-black T-shirt embodies the football fandom of Bangladesh and Plaantik’s journey over the decade.

The black-out concept of the t-shirt resonates with the idea that football fandom starts for the country when the lights go out. Throughout the last decade, Plaantik aimed to provide the passionate football fanbase with the latest news and live updates, occasionally through entire nights; so, they only found it fitting to release an all-black streetwear to commemorate ten years of their relationship with the fans.

Like Plaantik, Gorur Ghash has been a prominent name among the youth; so, the fusion between the two brands has been seamless in coming up with the concept. The t-shirt features the well-known emblems of Plaantik and Gorur Ghash sewn in solid black in the front. The stylized and recognizable typeface for “Plaantik” is embossed in black across the chest and features a Roman “X” on the back of the shirt to mimic a football jersey.

Plaantik 10 Year Commemorative Blackout Unisex Tee will only be available for purchase during a 3-day window on Gorur Ghash’s website starting November 4th, 2021.

  • Fabric: Premium quality Lycra cotton mix fabric. Light and breathable.
